programs.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programs.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu reserve, a female leopard gives birth to two cubs and will do everything in her power to protect them.Progressing climate change causes resources to shrink, which leads to growing conflicts over territory.The film, which is the result of three years of careful observations, reveals previously unseen fascinating behaviors of these mysterious predators.Thanks to unique recordings, viewers can take a closer look at the fight for leopards' survival in a changing world.

programs.title: Savage Kingdom
programs.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.
